claim.claim-text: 1. A device configured to stimulate a diaphragm to provoke motion of the diaphragm during inspiration, wherein the stimulation of the diaphragm comprises the following steps:
2. The device of claim 1, wherein the device is a medical device for use with a mechanical ventilator both coupled to a patient, said medical device comprising:

wherein said inspiratory event trigger and said end inspiratory event trigger together define a duration for the stimulation within the inspiratory phase of said single selected breath; and a power/work measuring device coupled to said instrumented wye and configured to measure the instantaneous work throughout the inspiratory phase of said single selected breath by comparing a predicted pressure at the wye and a measured pressure at the wye, and indicate work only if the predicted pressure differs from the measured pressure at said instrumented wye.
3. The device of claim 2 wherein said inspiratory trigger event is a patient initiated event.
4. The device of claim 2 wherein said end inspiratory trigger event is a patient initiated event.
5. The device of claim 2 wherein said inspiratory trigger event is a mechanical ventilator initiated event.
6. The device of claim 2 wherein said end inspiratory trigger event is a mechanical ventilator initiated event.
7. The device of claim 2 further including: an indicator presenting the level of stimulation delivered during said duration of the single selected breath.

8. The device of claim 2 further including: an indicator presenting the measured total power and total work for the level of stimulation delivered during the said duration of said single selected breath.
a device according to any preceding claim; and a mechanical ventilator configured to be coupled to a patient.
